name: bonnetcheck-rules-tests
description: Firestore rules tests that EXECUTE the rules, against the emulator. The Dart suite can only string-match firestore.rules, which is why SEC-20 shipped green.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project bonnetcheck-rules-test "node service_while_listed.mjs && node service_count_honest.mjs && node place_integrity.mjs"
